text:
Yes, according to our plant safety information, the spider plant is on our pet-safe list, so it's fine to have around your cats.

If you're also considering other plants, these are **not** pet-safe: monstera, pothos, peace lily, snake plant, ZZ plant, and fiddle leaf fig. Other pet-safe options are calathea, parlour palm, Boston fern, and peperomia.

If you think one of your cats has eaten any plant and seems unwell, contact your vet or a pet poison control service first, before anything else.

Our Plant Care Specialists are also happy to give free care advice by chat or email.
